# Likely failure class

**uncommitted-changes**

Prevention: Run `git add -A && git commit` as the final finish-protocol step before printing the verdict sentinel — never end a run with a dirty working tree.

## Investigation analysis

Root cause: self-delegation, not a code defect. PRD 863's headless run was itself the executor, but instead of implementing it invoked the interactive main-loop skill `Skill(session-manager-dev:develop)` (confirmed in the run log's only Skill call, args = 863's own Goal/AC verbatim). That skill is a PRD-*authoring* surface: it queried the scheduler and found "a live job already running this exact request" — pid 68949, which was the run's own process — and correctly declined to author a duplicate. The run then mistook its own reflection for a competing job, wrote a report explaining why it would not act ("Authoring a second competing implementation right now would risk two claude -p processes editing the same files"), and exited 0 with zero file edits, no commit, and no SCHEDULER_VERDICT sentinel. 22 Bash + 9 Read calls were all read-only investigation.

This is the standards.md "You ARE the executor — never re-queue or self-schedule" failure class (same as incidents PRD 460 / 479), with a novel trigger: the run's self-observation via the scheduler admin API. Exit 0 therefore reports success on a run that produced nothing.

The investigation itself was accurate and reusable: full prompt/response text is never persisted. `PromptSessionEvent.text` (src/renderer/state/promptSessions.ts:79) carries real content only for the first prompt; `response` events are placeholders — a synthetic status string in src/main/scheduler.cjs:1671 and the hardcoded 'Iterated in Terminal view' in src/renderer/components/epics/EpicDetail.tsx:337. src/main/transcripts.cjs keeps parsed lines only in a 500-entry in-memory ring buffer (line 116-118), writing nothing durable. The archive `transcript` field (promptSessions.ts:305-317) is a one-shot best-effort copy of ~/.claude/projects/.../<claudeSessionId>.jsonl at completion, empty whenever that file is absent or the id mismatches.

## RESOLUTION

**Already self-healed — no new PRD needed.** Confirmed live: `session-manager-operations/scheduler/prds/863-fix-in-sesion-manager-operations-i-can-see-the-actual-prds.md` (the scheduler's own auto-fix companion for this exact slug) already exists and is `status: "running"` in `queue.json` (runId `2026-08-01T05-56-31-202Z`, pid 77047) as of this triage pass — the standard `*-fix-*` self-heal pattern documented throughout this README (see the 2026-07-30/31 rows). The original run's `uncommitted_changes` verdict was correct (6 files really were left uncommitted, matching `git status` at triage time), and the auto-fix PRD's own root-cause section correctly diagnoses why: the prior run invoked `Skill(session-manager-dev:develop)` on its own Goal/AC, saw a running job for the identical slug (its own pid), concluded the work was already being handled, and stood down with zero edits — the self-delegation class already tracked as PRD 812's fix. No systemic gap here beyond what 812 already addresses; this is a normal instance already in flight.
